name: reflect, expand or contract a simplex of points
mechanism: keep a set of one more point than the dimension, replace the worst by its reflection through the centroid of the others, expanding if that helped a lot and contracting toward the best if it did not, shrinking the whole set when nothing helps

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Nelder–Mead method (downhill simplex method)' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: a nonlinear optimization algorithm

fails_when: can converge to a non-stationary point; degenerates in high dimension
